_meta.name: rank_correlation_matrix
_meta.description: Spearman and Kendall tau-b correlation matrices of price, income and label on training_data.pulse via params.method: each member is ranked first, so a cell reads any steady rise or fall, not only a straight line, and equals TEST_SPEARMAN_R / TEST_KENDALL_TAU over the pair's rows. Rank methods are buffered and not mergeable (predict reports streamable and mergeable false), take frequency weights only, and report no p-values.
